description: Somos un equipo de 2do de Primaria del North Schools de Punta del Este, nos gusta resolver desafíos a través de las ciencias.
summary: For the project, we programmed a video game that shows the conversations the crew might have if they encounter asteroids that could damage the ship.
details: In this video game, when you press play, you first see a conversation among the crew; then, on the next screen, you maneuver the crew so that the ship can dodge asteroids.
projectRefs: Environment for creating the video game
